title: WitnessCell v14 preregistered confirmatory computational replication: result package
description: Post-registration AutoDL execution of the frozen WitnessCell v14 workflow associated with OSF registration xrsmd. All five prespecified criteria passed. Twelve target-free deployment archives and all 156 arrays were reproduced elementwise exactly, with global maximum absolute difference 0. The eight active evidence-gate splits and four exact fallbacks were recovered, and the frozen 654-unit paired summary was reproduced. The C5 result is an integrity audit of inherited Gate18 aggregation, not a new Gate19/v14 raw-h5ad six-metric rescoring. The registration disclosed the earlier successful execution. This package contains no wet-lab experiment, new biological measurement or prospective biological outcome claim.
